items.reason: Glioblastoma appears only in keywords. Conditions say "Central Nervous System Tumor" and inclusion says "primary malignant central nervous system tumor". Under C7/D27B, keywords do not count as naming glioblastoma.

note: The trial also fails S6 because tozuleristide is a fluorescence-guided-surgery diagnostic_agent, so the population question does not change inclusion. Harmonisation (clarified D31-C1): exclusion reason is excluded_intervention_type because the Canvas imaging device is under test with the diagnostic agent.

harmonisation.reason: The tested arm is 'Tozuleristide with Canvas imaging system' (Device: Canvas imaging system), so a non-drug intervention is under test and clarified D31-C1 requires excluded_intervention_type.
